title: 高盛Kendra Lau：盈利拐点已现，市场为何不买账？
speaker: Kendra Lau

segments.en: And we think that we'll likely provide some support for short-duration equities and banks with fit into that category. Can you explain why is it that, given you said in your report, we are closed to this earnings inflection point.
segments.zh: 我们认为这可能为短久期权益资产和银行板块提供一定支撑。您能否解释一下，鉴于报告提到我们正接近盈利拐点。

segments.en: I mean, second quarter, you mentioned, is 20 percent gain, which is the highest in five years.
segments.zh: 您提到第二季度有20%的涨幅，是五年来的最高水平。

segments.en: And we just got the industrial profit numbers, which is quite a big jump.
segments.zh: 而我们刚看到的工业企业利润数据也出现了较大幅度跃升。

segments.en: And yes, we continue to see the market reaction, looking pretty like last, but there seems to be a disconnect there.
segments.zh: 是的，我们持续看到市场反应与数据似乎有些脱节。

segments.en: What is going on? I mean, if you look at the internal of the markets, essentially again, banks, or cash return themes, dividends, they've done well.
segments.zh: 这是怎么回事？如果看市场内部结构，本质上银行、现金回报主题和股息策略表现不错。

segments.en: But the areas that are seeing some pressure, obviously, is the AI part of the economy in the equity market.
segments.zh: 但明显承压的领域是权益市场中与AI相关的部分。

segments.en: And I think, as we discussed with Yvonne, I asked that question.
segments.zh: 正如我们与Yvonne讨论时，我提出了那个问题。

segments.en: I think the global beta remains a drag for the AI tech for now.
segments.zh: 我认为目前全球beta对AI科技板块仍是拖累。

segments.en: So when you kind of take a step back, if you look at the aggregate index, right now, valuations are back to very attractive levels.
segments.zh: 所以退一步看，如果观察综合指数，目前估值已回到非常有吸引力的水平。

segments.en: As you mentioned, that the national team is stepping up, stepping in, right?
segments.zh: 正如您提到的，国家队正在加大力度、介入市场，对吗？

segments.en: And on our estimate, just in the past two weeks, national team has net bought about 200 billion worth of Asia equities.
segments.zh: 据我们估算，仅过去两周，国家队净买入约2000亿港元的亚洲权益资产。

segments.en: So we think that we're likely to pull a floor, Alice, in the short term, when it comes to liquidity and sentiment.
segments.zh: 因此我们认为，短期内流动性和情绪可能获得支撑，Alice。
